_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Zandronum
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The multiplayer Doom port: cooperative, deathmatch, capture the flag and more. Installs any Zandronum release with Freedoom's free game data, and plays your own Doom WADs.
startup: a=(); for f in dmflags dmflags2 zadmflags compatflags compatflags2 zacompatflags; do v=${f^^}; [ -z "${!v}" ] || a+=(+set "$f" "${!v}"); done; for w in {{PWADS}}; do a+=(-file "PWAD/$w"); done; [ -z "{{SKILL}}" ] || a+=(-skill "{{SKILL}}"); exec ./zandronum-server -config zandronum.ini -host {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -iwad "IWAD/{{IWAD}}" "${a[@]}" +sv_hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +sv_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" +sv_forcepassword "$([ -n "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" +sv_rconpassword "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +{{GAME_MODE}} 1 +exec server.cfg +map "{{MAP}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Zandronum. Downloads the chosen Zandronum release for Linux from
# zandronum.com, and Freedoom's free game data from its GitHub releases
# (checked against Freedoom's checksums). Your WADs in IWAD/ and PWAD/,
# server.cfg and the admin, ban and whitelists are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# zandronum.com shows browsers a bot check; it lets plain clients through.
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
site=https://zandronum.com/downloads
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

page=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$site/") || fail "zandronum.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
versions=$(grep -oE 'zandronum[0-9][0-9.]*-linux-x86_64\.tar\.bz2' <<<"$page" | sed -E 's/^zandronum(.*)-linux.*/\1/' | sort -uV)
[ -n "$versions" ] || fail "zandronum.com lists no Linux downloads right now. Reinstall to try again later."
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    version=$(tail -n 1 <<<"$versions")
elif ! grep -qxF "$version" <<<"$versions"; then
    fail "Zandronum has no Linux release $version. Set Version to latest, or to one of: $(echo $versions)."
fi

if [ -x zandronum-server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Zandronum $version is already installed."
else
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading Zandronum $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/z.tar.bz2" "$site/zandronum$version-linux-x86_64.tar.bz2" ||
        fail "The download from zandronum.com failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # zandronum.com publishes no checksums, so check the archive is whole.
    bzip2 -tq "$build/z.tar.bz2" || fail "The download from zandronum.com was damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xjf "$build/z.tar.bz2" -C "$build/x"
    [ -x "$build/x/zandronum-server" ] || fail "Zandronum $version's download has no server in it. Choose another version."
    rm -f "$build/x/zandronum"   # the game client
    cp -f "$build/x"/* .
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

# Freedoom: free game data (IWADs) that plays the Doom and Doom II maps.
mkdir -p IWAD PWAD
fd=$(gh-release tag freedoom/freedoom latest 2>/dev/null) || fd=""
if [ -z "$fd" ]; then
    echo "Freedoom's releases can't be reached right now, so its game data wasn't updated."
elif [ -f IWAD/freedoom1.wad ] && [ "$(cat IWAD/.freedoom-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$fd" ]; then
    echo "Freedoom ${fd#v} is already installed."
else
    v=${fd#v}
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/fd"
    echo "Downloading Freedoom $v"
    gh-release download freedoom/freedoom "$fd" "freedoom-$v-CHECKSUM" "$build/sums" || fail "Freedoom's download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    for z in "freedoom-$v.zip" "freedm-$v.zip"; do
        gh-release download freedoom/freedoom "$fd" "$z" "$build/$z" || fail "Freedoom's download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        want=$(sed -n "s/^SHA256 ($z) = \([0-9a-f]*\)$/\1/p" "$build/sums")
        [ -n "$want" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$z" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$want" ] ||
            fail "Freedoom's download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -qjo "$build/$z" '*.wad' -d "$build/fd"
    done
    mv -f "$build/fd"/*.wad IWAD/
    echo "$fd" > IWAD/.freedoom-version
fi

touch adminlist.txt whitelist.txt banlist.txt
# Zandronum finds its home folder through the system's user list, which has
# no entry for the server's user, and then uses a folder named ~ here.
mkdir -p "~"
if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
    cat > server.cfg <<'CFG'
// Zandronum server settings, run at every start. The name, passwords,
// players, map and game mode are set from the server's variables.
sv_motd "Welcome!"
sv_maxlives 0
sv_updatemaster 1
sv_broadcast 1
CFG
fi
echo "Installed Zandronum $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Zandronum release, such as 3.2.1, or latest for the newest: the same one your players have. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password for the remote console. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: cooperative, survival, invasion, deathmatch, teamplay, duel, terminator, lastmanstanding, teamlms, possession, teampossession, ctf, oneflagctf, skulltag or domination.

variables.name: IWAD
variables.description: The game data in IWAD/: freedoom1.wad (Doom maps), freedoom2.wad (Doom II maps), freedm.wad (deathmatch), or a Doom WAD you upload.

variables.name: PWADs
variables.description: Add-on WADs or PK3s from PWAD/ to load, separated by spaces.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to start on, such as e1m1 for Doom maps or map01 for Doom II maps.

variables.name: Skill
variables.description: The difficulty, from 1 (easiest) to 5 (hardest). Empty uses the default, 3.

variables.name: Gameplay flags
variables.description: The dmflags value, a number. Empty leaves the default.

variables.name: More gameplay flags
variables.description: The dmflags2 value, a number. Empty leaves the default.

variables.name: Zandronum gameplay flags
variables.description: The zadmflags value, a number. Empty leaves the default.

variables.name: Compatibility flags
variables.description: The compatflags value, a number. Empty leaves the default.

variables.name: More compatibility flags
variables.description: The compatflags2 value, a number. Empty leaves the default.

variables.name: Zandronum compatibility flags
variables.description: The zacompatflags value, a number. Empty leaves the default.
